AwarenessStage.Objective: Increase brand visibility and capture the attention of potential customers.

InStoreMetrics.TargetAudienceReach: % Target Audience Reach: Measure how much of the intended audience sees the in-store media (e.g., signages, screens).
InStoreMetrics.HouseholdsReached: Number of households exposed to in-store media.
InStoreMetrics.Impressions: Number of times customers see static assets, such as posters or digital screens.
InStoreMetrics.ScreensWithCameras: Track impressions using screens equipped with cameras to measure engagement.

OnlineMetrics.Impressions: Number of times ads are displayed online.
OnlineMetrics.ShareOfSearch: How frequently the brand appears in search results relative to competitors.
OnlineMetrics.ImpressionShare: Proportion of eligible impressions your ads received.
OnlineMetrics.BrandSearchUplift: Increase in brand searches following an advertising campaign.

ConsiderationStage.Objective: Engage customers and encourage them to consider the brand or product.

InStoreMetrics.EngagementOnInteractiveScreens: Clicks, swipes, and interactions on in-store digital screens.
InStoreMetrics.FootfallProximityEngagement: Number of visitors interacting with shop-in-shop (SiS) experiences, especially those equipped with eye-tracking cameras, Bluetooth, or WiFi.
InStoreMetrics.StaticAssetsEngagement: Number of store visits generated by static in-store media.

OnlineMetrics.CTR: Percentage of people who click on an online ad after seeing it.
OnlineMetrics.VCR: Percentage of viewers who watch an entire video ad.
OnlineMetrics.DPVR: Views on specific product detail pages, indicating deeper engagement.

InStoreMetrics.OverallSalesUplift: Increase in sales attributed to in-store media efforts.
InStoreMetrics.ROAS: Return on advertising spend specific to in-store ads.
InStoreMetrics.InteractionsDirectContacts: Track interactions like gift distributions and direct customer engagements linked to in-store media.
InStoreMetrics.TrafficStoreVisits: Number of visitors entering the store influenced by in-store advertising.

OnlineMetrics.ConversionRate: Percentage of visitors who make a purchase after interacting with an ad.
OnlineMetrics.AddToBasketVsBasketAbandonment: Track the ratio of products added to carts versus those abandoned.
OnlineMetrics.Sales_iROAS: Measure sales attributed to online advertising efforts.
OnlineMetrics.CPA: The cost incurred to acquire a customer through online ads.

ExperienceStage.Objective: Enhance post-purchase satisfaction and encourage repeat engagement.

InStoreMetrics.CustomerFeedbackSurveys: Collect qualitative feedback from in-store surveys or engagement activities.
InStoreMetrics.RepeatPurchasers: Track the percentage of customers who make repeat purchases influenced by in-store media.
InStoreMetrics.InStoreRadioEngagement: Measure engagement levels linked to in-store radio, particularly during prime times.

OnlineMetrics.LTV: The total value a customer brings over their lifetime of engagement with the brand.
OnlineMetrics.RepurchaseRate: Percentage of customers who return to purchase again.
OnlineMetrics.FrequencyOfPurchase: How often customers buy after the initial engagement.
OnlineMetrics.DetailedExperienceMetrics: Metrics such as video reviews, ratings, and post-purchase interactions.

KeyIntegrationPoints.DataSynchronization: Integrate data from both in-store and online sources to get a holistic view of customer behavior.
KeyIntegrationPoints.UnifiedAttributionModels: Use cross-channel attribution to understand the combined effect of in-store and online touchpoints on sales.
KeyIntegrationPoints.PerformanceReporting: Align in-store and online KPIs in regular reports to track overall campaign effectiveness and adjust strategies accordingly.
KeyIntegrationPoints.FeedbackLoop: Use insights from both channels to continuously refine marketing efforts, ensuring each stage of the PDJ is optimized.

UnifiedMeasurementFramework.Conclusion: This unified framework ensures that all specific KPIs and metrics are aligned to comprehensively measure and optimize retail media across both in-store and online environments. By connecting these metrics, brands can better understand their marketing impact, enhance customer engagement, and drive overall sales growth.
